title: Async Brighton — Web Performance, End to End
description: Async is Brighton's long-running, inclusive monthly web-tech meetup. This August session features a talk by Niall Coleman-Clarke on web performance, with pizza and drinks provided; talks are free and beginner-welcoming.
address: York and Elder Works, 50 New England St, Brighton BN1 4AW

title: codebar Brighton — Free Coding Workshop
description: codebar runs free evening coding workshops that pair beginners one-to-one with experienced coaches, aimed at people underrepresented in tech. This session is hosted at Octopus Energy; food is provided and all levels are welcome.

title: codebar Brighton — Free Coding Workshop (September)
description: A later date in codebar Brighton's fortnightly free-workshop series, hosted at MPB. Complete beginners are paired with coaches to work through a project at their own pace; a laptop is all you need.

title: JavaScript Brighton — Monthly Meetup
description: A relaxed, social JavaScript networking group that meets on the third Thursday of each month in a pub near Brighton beach. Open to all levels; good for casual networking rather than formal talks. Date is the group's regular monthly cadence.

title: BrightonPy — Python Meetup
description: Brighton's Python user group (supported by Silicon Brighton and hosted by data consultancy Datacove) meets for informal talks on Python, data and related tools, with conversation continuing in the bar afterwards.

title: PHP Sussex — Monthly Meetup
description: A free, open-to-all monthly PHP and web-development meetup based in Brighton. The group is on a summer break and resumes in September; date reflects its usual monthly cadence and should be confirmed on Meetup.

title: UX Brighton 2026 — Emerging Methods
description: One of Europe's premier UX conferences, held annually at Brighton Dome. The 2026 theme is 'Emerging Methods', featuring practitioners on new and borrowed techniques that are actually working in UX. Expect around 400 designers and decision-makers.

title: FFConf 2026
description: A respected single-track front-end and web-development conference in Brighton, now in its long-running annual run at the Duke of York's cinema. Eight sessions on accessibility, AI, web components, tooling, community and the workplace, with an after-party for networking.

title: HackSussex 2027 (annual student hackathon)
description: The University of Sussex's in-person student hackathon: a 24-hour build event on campus in Falmer with free food, swag and prizes, welcoming beginners. The 2026 edition ran in late February; date is the projected next annual occurrence — confirm nearer the time.

title: London AI, ML & Computer Vision Meetup
description: An in-person evening of talks on cutting-edge AI, machine learning and computer vision at Imperial College London, hosted by Voxel51's Jimmy Guerrero. Sessions cover multi-modal models, 3D tokenization, agentic engineering and production CV systems.

title: London Node.js User Group (LNUG)
description: A friendly, long-running monthly meetup for people using Node.js, with talks from practitioners and time to network. Free to attend and open to all levels. Date reflects the group's regular monthly cadence — confirm the venue on Meetup.

title: JavaScript Monthly London (JSMonthly)
description: A monthly London JavaScript meetup with talks and networking for web developers of all levels. Free to attend. Date reflects the group's regular monthly cadence — confirm the exact date and venue on Meetup.

title: London Python Meetup
description: A community meetup for anyone interested in Python, from complete beginners to seasoned professionals, with talks and networking. Free to attend. Date reflects the group's regular monthly cadence — confirm the exact date and venue on Meetup.

title: London Machine Learning Meetup
description: One of Europe's largest ML/AI communities, with past speakers including Yoshua Bengio and Andrej Karpathy. In-person talks on cutting-edge machine learning; free to attend. Date reflects the group's typical monthly cadence — confirm the exact date and venue on Meetup.

title: Bright Network FESTIVAL 2026 (Morning Entry)
description: Billed as the UK's number-one graduate careers event, bringing thousands of students together with 80+ leading employers across three floors of the QEII Centre. Free for current university students graduating 2027–2030; strong for early-careers tech recruiting and networking.

title: techUK Cyber Innovation Den 2026
description: techUK's annual afternoon showcase of UK cyber-security innovation, where SME finalists pitch to expert judges, plus talks and a networking lunch. Free to attend in person or online at techUK's London office; register via techUK.

title: React Advanced London 2026
description: A major annual React conference (by GitNation) at The Brewery in the City of London, with 40+ speakers on advanced React and front-end topics plus 800+ in-person attendees. Conference days 23 and 26 October; workshops around the main event.

title: London Tech Job Fair 2026
description: A three-hour evening 'speed-dating for recruiting' event where employers meet tech talent directly for networking and hiring. Suitable for students and job-seekers exploring roles; organised by TechMeetups.
address: Bradfield Court, Hawley Rd, London NW1 8RN

title: IC Hack 2027 (annual student hackathon)
description: Imperial College London's DoCSoc runs what it calls the UK's biggest student-run hackathon — a 24-hour event for 700+ students focused on building, learning and networking, with meals, merch and sponsor prizes. Date is the projected next annual edition; tickets typically release in January.

title: NDC London 2027
description: A large, well-regarded software developers' conference at the QEII Centre in Westminster: two workshop days followed by three days of multi-track sessions across many technologies. A flagship UK dev conference worth travelling for.
